comment.body: The exact key-generation error is useful, and another participant has reported recovery after a complete reinstall. That does not yet identify the failure on this installation. Please reproduce once, comment `/bugreport`, and attach the resulting ZIP immediately afterward so we can distinguish peer-verification rejection from endpoint startup or another IPC failure. Please omit pairing keys from screenshots.
